title: Three separate intelligence sources told Coulthart to watch Dark

tellings.quote: playbook, but they had all said, "Well, if you really want to understand what's going on, watch this Netflix series, Dark."

plain: Three separate intelligence sources each told an Australian journalist named Ross Coulthart, who reports on UFOs, that 'if you really want to understand what's going on, watch this Netflix series, Dark.' A Hollywood writer and producer named Bryce Zabel tells Michels this, passing on what Coulthart told him. If true, it would mean insiders were pointing to a TV drama as a guide to what they could not say outright.
